card_en: Weather talk has no word for English it. Use a verb alone, dežuje, it is raining, or je with the neuter form: mrzlo je, it is cold; vroče je, it is hot.

quick_check.explain_en: Weather talk uses the neuter form with je: mrzlo je, it is cold.

helper_de: German needs es: es regnet, es ist kalt. Slovenian needs no es: dežuje, mrzlo je.
helper_en: English needs it: it is raining. Slovenian has no word for it here.
